segments.text: Northbridge’s Cabinet agreed a food waste service:
The Cabinet agreed that weekly collections of food waste would begin in April 2026.

cited.cited_text: The Cabinet agreed that weekly collections of food waste would begin in April 2026.

segments.text: This makes Northbridge the first council in the county to do so.
